deadline.value: One strict deadline: December 15 (PhD and MSI, Fall). Year inferred.
deadline.quote: PhD and MSI Fall applications have one strict deadline: December 15.

gre_subject.value: Not required and no longer accepted
gre_subject.quote: We do not require the general or Physics GRE for any of our programs, and no longer accept these scores.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided centrally by the Admissions Committee; you do not need to contact faculty first, but should name faculty you would like to work with in your application.
supervisor.quote: All applications are evaluated centrally by the Admissions Committee – there’s no need to contact individual faculty, though you should mention in your application which faculty you’d be interested in working with.

funding.value: Full support for the duration; 9-month TA stipend USD 30,000 (+8,000 summer TA); RA salary 41,000 (2026)
funding.quote: PhD students receive full financial support for the duration of their studies. | The current 9-month TA stipend is $30,000, plus an additional $8,000 for a full summer TA position.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in physics or a closely related field is the stated requirement for the PhD; a Master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: For admission to the PhD, MA, or MSI programs, in addition to the Graduate School’s requirements, you need: | A bachelor’s degree in physics or a closely related field from an accredited institution.

app_fee.quote: An application fee of $100 is required.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate School waivers for domestic (US) applicants; a separate department program covers fees for Latin American applicants
fee_waiver.quote: Domestic (US) applicants may be eligible for a waiver – see the eligibility requirements and waiver procedure from the Graduate School.

gre_general.value: Not required and no longer accepted
gre_general.quote: We do not require the general or Physics GRE for any of our programs, and no longer accept these scores.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 5 overall on the current 1-6 scale for doctoral applicants (from Jan 21, 2026); higher speaking score needed to TA
toefl_min.quote: Under the TOEFL iBT’s current scoring scale (effective January 21, 2026), the minimum overall score is 5 for doctoral applicants and 4.5 for master’s applicants.

english_waiver.value: Exemption examples include a degree from an English-instruction institution
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who are not native or primary speakers of English, and don’t otherwise qualify for an exemption (e.g. a degree from an English-instruction institution, US citizenship/National status, or English-instruction TA experience), must submit TOEFL, IELTS, or Gateway English Test scores.

notes: Decisions only after December 15; offers must be accepted by April 15. The PhD in Physics offers a concentration in Astronomy (https://www.stonybrook.edu/commcms/grad-physics-astronomy/degrees/PhD.php), so astronomy is listed under also_fields. The Graduate School deadline table lists December 22, 2026 for Physics and Astronomy PhD; the department page says December 15.
